newsitem.title: UK: REUTERS HAS NO COMMENT ON REED BID TALK.
newsitem.headline: REUTERS HAS NO COMMENT ON REED BID TALK.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said on Sunday it had no comment on a Sunday Telegraph newspaper report it might make a hostile bid for Anglo-Dutch publisher Reed Elsevier .
"It is company policy never to comment on market rumours," a spokesman for Reuters said.

The Sunday Telegraph said there was growing speculation Reuters was contemplating a hostile bid for Reed Elsevier. The paper said tentative merger talks between the two had failed because of "cultural differences".
